title: About My Website
contents: My resume website aims to showcase a large majority of fullstack development practices, including modern frontend frameworks, particularly Angular, run on an Express JS server using Firestore as a document database, deployed on GCP.

The frontend of my website is built using Angular, so that I can take advantage of the opinionated nature of the framework and use the built-in router, HTTP client, forms module, and well-integrated Material component library.

The backend of my website is built on Express JS. Its primary function is to statically serve the front end to the client upon request. Additionally, It handles post requests from the frontend’s contact form, and stores documents in a firestore document database. Before storing however, it uses express validator to curate the document to the appropriate document type, as well as blocks any cross site scripting attacks.

title: Objective
contents: Ambitious, goal-oriented computer science student, seeking a challenging, fullstack web development, iOS developer, or language hacking position at Apple, Google, or Home Depot, where I can effectively utilize my fullstack web development knowledge in React, Angular, NodeJS, ExpressJS, and databases; bytecode interpreter knowledge in C / C++, and design patterns; or my experience with Swift, SwiftUI, and other supporting libraries, to contribute to a programming language like Swift or V8, or develop fast, beautiful, and secure web or native Apple OS apps. My aim is to professionally or regularly practice app development to ultimately foster a later career path focused on implementing an intuitive, fast, optimized, and powerful programming language  within a dynamic and growth-oriented environment which supports the open source community.

title: My Love for Programming
contents: Towards the end of high school, I decided to take a free online class for Swift and SwiftUI since I heard that’s what native iOS apps were developed in, and I wanted to expand my programming skills past the terminal output stream. Building my first app that I could not only test on my phone, but also in which I could interact with a real UI has since hooked me into the world of programming. Shortly after that, I turned my attention towards web development, and have been practicing and learning about the fullstack development process since. Recently however, I have been revisiting Swift, learning about building complex native applications, and integrating new AI features, such as computer vision, and text analysis, and I am currently working on writing my mother a cookbook app (which will hopefully eventually be on the app store).

College however, has introduced a new passion of mine, and that is the study of language. For my first three semesters, I studied Russian in a very fast paced environment and even spent a summer in Armenia and Georgia to further develop my language skills. But this extended into programming for me as well, and I have recently begun to study the process of developing programming languages and bytecode VMs. This area has brought me an incredible balance of my love for language, as well as my love for abstract, complicated, math-based problem solving to build tools that have a very real world impact, and is where I am looking to dedicate a very large portion, if not a majority of my career.
